options.text: to return to your home safely

questions.stem:
We do not know these streets and have no map. We may get lost.
What does “get lost” mean here?

translation.stem: 我们不熟悉这些街道，也没有地图。我们可能迷路。 这里“get lost”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “get lost” means “to lose your way and not know where you are”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“get lost”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to lose your way and not know where you are”。对应源表释义为“迷路”。

questions.stem: Mia g________ the park before her friends and waits at the gate.
questions.explanation: Mia takes gets; to links the verb to the place.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia为单数用gets；the park前保留to。

translation.stem: 米娅比朋友先到公园，在门口等候。

questions.stem: Mia g________ the bridge and reaches the island on the other side.
questions.hint: moves from one side to the other
questions.explanation: Mia is singular, so go becomes goes.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia单数，go变为goes，across保留。

translation.stem: 米娅走过桥，到达另一侧的岛。

questions.stem: Please do not g________. Stay here with us.
questions.explanation: After do not, use the base form go away.
questions.parentExplanation: go away表示走开、离开，与后句stay here对照。

translation.stem: 请不要离开。留在这里和我们一起。

questions.stem: After our visit, we g________ to school and return the maps.
questions.explanation: Go back to means return to a place.
questions.parentExplanation: go back表示回去；to后接返回的地点school。

translation.stem: 参观后，我们回学校归还地图。

questions.stem: Mia g________ to a new town with her family every summer.
questions.hint: travels somewhere for a visit or holiday
questions.explanation: Mia takes goes on a trip.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia为第三人称单数，go变goes，其余结构不变。

translation.stem: 米娅每年夏天和家人去一个新镇旅行。

questions.stem: Mia l________ the station at six to catch her train there.
questions.hint: starts a journey towards a named destination
questions.explanation: Mia takes leaves. The station is the destination after for.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia为单数用leaves；for后车站是要去的地方。

translation.stem: 米娅六点出发去车站，在那里赶火车。

questions.stem: My aunt grows potatoes beside her house. She w________ after the rain.
questions.hint: grow crops on the ground that belongs to the subject
questions.explanation: Here, “works her land” means “cultivate the ground to grow crops”. “She” takes works and the matching possessive her.
questions.parentExplanation: she对应第三人称单数works和物主代词her。完整句意：我的阿姨在房旁种土豆。下雨后她耕种自己的土地。

translation.stem: 我的阿姨在房旁种土豆。下雨后她耕种自己的土地。

questions.stem: In our experiment, a strong fan can b________ a small paper boat on the table.
questions.explanation: Use blow away after can to show that moving air carries the boat off.
questions.parentExplanation: can后填原形blow away；此处为风扇气流吹走纸船，不是其他引申义。

translation.stem: 在我们的实验中，强力风扇能把桌上的小纸船吹走。

questions.stem: What does “get there” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here, get there means arrive at that place. Sentence 2 gives its use: The teacher checks a map so that we can get there before the afternoon activity begins.
questions.parentExplanation: get there指到达社区阅览室，there前不加to。

translation.stem: 短文中的“get there”是什么意思？

questions.stem: What does “get her pen back” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here, get her pen back means recover an item that she previously had. Sentence 4 gives its use: She asks the worker politely and is pleased to get her pen back from the lost-property drawer.
questions.parentExplanation: get her pen back指取回原来遗失的笔；此处不是返回某地。

translation.stem: 短文中的“get her pen back”是什么意思？

questions.stem: Where does Mia recover her pen?
questions.explanation: Sentence 4 specifies the lost-property drawer.
questions.parentExplanation: 第4句明确是失物抽屉。

translation.stem: 米娅从哪里取回笔？

options.label: B
options.text: From a book she buys at the door.

options.label: D
options.text: From the lake beside her home.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The visit combines the planned book delivery with recovering a forgotten item.
questions.parentExplanation: 送书是主线，期间取回失物，最后参加阅读活动。

translation.stem: 主旨是什么？

options.label: A
options.text: Mia teaches a worker to draw maps.

options.label: B
options.text: A reading room is turned into a sports shop.

options.label: C
options.text: Delivering books leads to a useful visit and a recovered pen.

options.label: D
options.text: A class decides to stop lending books.

questions.stem: What does “get in” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here, get in means arrive at a station. Sentence 2 gives its use: Their train will get in at ten, so we have time to practise our welcome.
questions.parentExplanation: get in在火车时刻语境为到达车站，不是收割。

translation.stem: 短文中的“get in”是什么意思？

options.label: D
options.text: leaving a bus at a stop

questions.stem: What does “getting on” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here, getting on means making progress. Sentence 3 gives its use: Ben asks how the recording project is getting on while we wait.
questions.parentExplanation: getting on在询问项目时为进展，不是上车。

translation.stem: 短文中的“getting on”是什么意思？

questions.stem: What problem does the team help solve?
questions.explanation: Sentences 4 and 5 identify the recording-space need and the empty music room.
questions.parentExplanation: 第4、5句说明需要安静录音地点，因而借出音乐室。

translation.stem: 广播队帮助解决什么问题？

options.label: A
options.text: The train has no seats for the visitors.

options.label: B
options.text: Two speakers need a quiet place for recording.

options.label: C
options.text: The opening music is missing from every copy.

options.label: D
options.text: Ben cannot find the name of his school.

questions.stem: Which title is best?
questions.explanation: A question about progress reveals a problem that the waiting team can solve.
questions.parentExplanation: 问项目进展发现问题，等待者帮忙解决。

translation.stem: 哪个标题最好？

passages.text: Our class must take a box of books to the community reading room. The teacher checks a map so that we can get there before the afternoon activity begins. At the door, Mia remembers a pen she left behind on her last visit. She asks the worker politely and is pleased to get her pen back from the lost-property drawer. Then everyone carries a few books to the low shelves and checks their labels. We finish in time and stay to hear younger children choose their first story.

parallelText.en: Our class must take a box of books to the community reading room.
parallelText.zh: 我们班要送一箱书到社区阅览室。

parallelText.en: The teacher checks a map so that we can get there before the afternoon activity begins.
parallelText.zh: 老师查看地图，好让我们在下午活动开始前到达那里。

parallelText.en: At the door, Mia remembers a pen she left behind on her last visit.
parallelText.zh: 到门口时，米娅想起上次遗留的一支笔。

parallelText.en: She asks the worker politely and is pleased to get her pen back from the lost-property drawer.
parallelText.zh: 她礼貌地询问工作人员，很高兴从失物抽屉里取回自己的笔。

parallelText.en: Then everyone carries a few books to the low shelves and checks their labels.
parallelText.zh: 随后，大家搬几本书到低书架上，检查标签。

parallelText.en: We finish in time and stay to hear younger children choose their first story.
parallelText.zh: 我们及时完成，并留下听小孩子选择第一个故事。

wordHelp.meaning: a sliding box inside a piece of furniture

passages.text: Our school radio team is waiting for a visiting group from another town. Their train will get in at ten, so we have time to practise our welcome. Ben asks how the recording project is getting on while we wait. Mia says the opening music is ready, but two speakers still need a quiet place to record. We offer the empty music room and carry a microphone there before the visitors arrive. The waiting time becomes useful because one question helps us notice and solve a small problem.

parallelText.en: Our school radio team is waiting for a visiting group from another town.
parallelText.zh: 学校广播队正在等另一座城镇的来访小组。

parallelText.en: Their train will get in at ten, so we have time to practise our welcome.
parallelText.zh: 他们的火车十点到达，因此我们还有时间练习欢迎词。

parallelText.en: Ben asks how the recording project is getting on while we wait.
parallelText.zh: 等待时，本询问录音项目进展怎样。

parallelText.en: Mia says the opening music is ready, but two speakers still need a quiet place to record.
parallelText.zh: 米娅说开场音乐好了，但两位发言者仍需要安静地点录音。

parallelText.en: We offer the empty music room and carry a microphone there before the visitors arrive.
parallelText.zh: 我们提供空着的音乐室，并在来访者到达前把麦克风搬进去。

parallelText.en: The waiting time becomes useful because one question helps us notice and solve a small problem.
parallelText.zh: 这段等待变得有用，因为一个问题帮助我们发现并解决了小问题。
